_comment: Single source of truth for prosthetic-conscience's local tool dependencies. Consumed by the shared toolchain probe (tools/internal/toolchain), used by both the hook binaries and /prosthetic-conscience:doctor. See plans/claude-port-plan.md §3a'.

tools.name: git
tools.purpose: version control; the blackboard is git-tracked

tools.name: gh
tools.purpose: GitHub PR / review flow; a Claude Code cloud session reaches GitHub through MCP tools instead and ships no gh, so its absence there is by design, not a defect

tools.name: qlty
tools.purpose: format + lint quality gate (sc-quality-gate runs it)

tools.name: jq
tools.purpose: JSON slicing for diagnostics and key-scoped settings reads

_hook_binaries._project_root: Every hook here resolves the project root through internal/hookenv: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR first, then the payload's cwd, then NOTHING (never os.Getwd(), which would write session state into whatever directory the process started in). Seven of these read the environment variable alone and went silent when it was unset — silence a caller cannot tell apart from having nothing to do. A test walks cmd/*/main.go and fails on any hook that resolves it privately.
_hook_binaries._comment: OUR compiled HOOKS, not external deps. One per directory under tools/cmd/ EXCEPT sc-doctor, which is an operator command rather than a hook and is provisioned the same way. scripts/pluginparity fails when this list and tools/cmd/ disagree — it drifted twice before that check existed (sc-strike-counter was never added; the PostToolUse pair outlived its merge). /prosthetic-conscience:doctor --fix fetches the CI-built release asset <name>_{goos}_{goarch}{exe} (SHA256-verified) into bin/, falling back to go build only as a dev convenience. hooks.json invokes ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/<name>.

binaries.name: sc-pretooluse
binaries.purpose: ONE hook for the event: the secrets gate (fails CLOSED, can deny) and the push-freeze guard (never blocks) as units over one shared context, each keeping its own matcher and its own posture. Separate binaries until #201 step 3.

binaries.name: sc-posttooluse
binaries.purpose: ONE hook for the event, running the quality gate and the recall index as units over one shared context: payload parsed once, project root resolved once, ONE writer for the hook log. They were separate binaries until #201 step 3.

binaries.name: sc-toolchain-nudge
binaries.purpose: one-line warning when a recommended tool is missing

binaries.name: sc-checkpoint-seal
binaries.purpose: seals CHECKPOINT.md to a pruned snapshot dir at every seam — a compaction, a session ending, a seat finishing. Takes -event from hooks.json rather than inferring it from the payload. Emits compact instructions on PreCompact ONLY, naming only what the note already carries; silent elsewhere, because stdout on SubagentStop reaches a live seat. Never blocks, and stays cheap because auto-compaction thrashes

binaries.name: sc-checkpoint-restore
binaries.purpose: hands the session back its own checkpoint as additionalContext — on EVERY source, because SessionStart is the only hook that can inject at a compaction boundary; a pointer rather than the digest on clear and on status: done. Also registers watchPaths from the note's validation-loop trigger surfaces — as DIRECTORIES, since watchPaths takes no patterns of any kind (hook-surface-spike.md §6) — and reports the surfaces it could not resolve rather than watching nothing silently

binaries.name: sc-postcompact-observe
binaries.purpose: records how much of the note's vocabulary each harness summary carried, one append-only row per boundary — observation only, because PostCompact cannot inject and runs after the restore has already fired

binaries.name: sc-filechanged-rearm
binaries.purpose: marks a validation check stale when a file under its trigger surface changes, so a resumed agent cannot trust `last run: pass` for a check whose inputs moved. Attributes by longest-matching surface, records nothing for unclaimed changes, and ignores everything under .claude/ so the hooks' own writes cannot re-trigger them

binaries.name: sc-strike-counter
binaries.purpose: Counts repeated failures of the same (tool, target) so anti-spinning's 3-strike limit is not enforced by the agent against itself. Skips user interrupts.
